definitions.gloss: iron rod; metal club; iron staff
definitions.explanation: A heavy bar or club made of iron or metal, used as a tool or weapon. In folklore it is the signature weapon of the {鬼|おに} (ogre), which is why it figures in the well-known idiom below.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鬼|おに}→鬼：02184_oni⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{金棒|かなぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: The ogre is holding an iron club.

examples.japanese: ⟦{重|おも}い→重い：00804_omoi⟧{金棒|かなぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{両手|りょうて}→両手：09518_ryoute⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{振|ふ}り{回|まわ}した→振り回す：06051_furimawasu⟧。
examples.english: He swung the heavy iron rod around with both hands.

examples.japanese: ⟦{経験|けいけん}{豊富|ほうふ}→経験豊富：19017_keikenhoufu⟧な⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{加|くわ}われば→加わる：01940_kuwawaru⟧、⟦{鬼|おに}→鬼：02184_oni⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{金棒|かなぼう}だ。
examples.english: With an experienced person like him joining, we'll be invincible.

notes:
A heavy iron bar or club. In modern Japanese it is encountered most often in the idiom below rather than as a literal weapon.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{鬼|おに}→鬼：02184_oni⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{金棒|かなぼう}: lit. 'an iron club for an ogre' — making something already strong even stronger; an unbeatable combination
- {金棒|かなぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}り{回|まわ}す→振り回す：06051_furimawasu⟧: to swing an iron club

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{棒|ぼう}→棒：03726_bou⟧: rod; stick — the general word for a bar of any material
- ⟦{鉄棒|てつぼう}→鉄棒：17912_tetsubou⟧: iron bar; (gymnastics) horizontal bar — overlaps in literal sense but also names the playground/gymnastics apparatus
